targetText: It wasn't easy for a proletarian to act like a manager. She told him so.
explanation: The corrupting influence of managerial authority during the NEP period as former revolutionaries succumb to petty-bourgeois privileges.

targetText: You see only one side of my life. And you refuse to understand. If you could read my heart, how hard I tried all winter, you wouldn't condemn me.
explanation: Volodya rationalizes his adoption of luxury habits by pleading executive stress, illustrating how bureaucratization distorts communist ethics.
